## Proof

Let the origin be \(O\). Write the position vectors
\[
\vec a=\overrightarrow{OA},\quad \vec b=\overrightarrow{OB},\quad \vec c=\overrightarrow{OC},
\qquad |\vec a|=2,\;|\vec b|=9,\;|\vec c|=12.
\]
For any triangle \(ABC\),
\[
2[ABC]=\bigl|\vec a\times\vec b+\vec b\times\vec c+\vec c\times\vec a\bigr|.
\]
Using \(\vec b\times\vec c=-\vec c\times\vec b\),
\[
\vec a\times\vec b+\vec b\times\vec c+\vec c\times\vec a
=\vec a\times\vec b+\vec c\times(\vec a-\vec b).
\]

**Step 1 — optimize over \(C\).** Fix \(A,B\). The quantity \(\vec c\times(\vec a-\vec b)\) equals \(|\vec c|\,|\vec a-\vec b|\sin\varphi\), where \(\varphi\) is the angle from \((\vec a-\vec b)\) to \(\vec c\). Since \(\vec c\) ranges over the whole circle of radius \(12\), this is maximized by taking \(\vec c\perp(\vec a-\vec b)\) with the correct orientation, giving
\[
\max_{C}\;2[ABC]=\vec a\times\vec b+12\,|\vec a-\vec b|.
\]

**Step 2 — optimize over \(A,B\).** Let \(\theta\) be the directed angle from \(\vec a\) to \(\vec b\). Then
\[
\vec a\times\vec b=18\sin\theta,\qquad
|\vec a-\vec b|^{2}=4+81-36\cos\theta=85-36\cos\theta.
\]
So we maximize
\[
F(\theta)=18\sin\theta+12\sqrt{85-36\cos\theta}.
\]
Setting \(F'(\theta)=0\) (and noting the maximum has \(\sin\theta\ge 0\), \(\cos\theta<0\)):
\[
18\cos\theta+\frac{216\sin\theta}{\sqrt{85-36\cos\theta}}=0
\;\Longrightarrow\;
\cos\theta\,\sqrt{85-36\cos\theta}=-12\sin\theta.
\]
Squaring with \(x=\cos\theta\):
\[
x^{2}(85-36x)=144(1-x^{2})
\;\Longrightarrow\;
36x^{3}-229x^{2}+144=0.
\]
Factoring,
\[
36x^{3}-229x^{2}+144=(4x+3)(9x^{2}-64x+48).
\]
The root with \(x<0\) is \(x=-\tfrac34\) (the quadratic roots lie outside the valid sign region). One checks \(x=-\tfrac34\) satisfies the unsquared equation.

**Step 3 — compute the maximum.** At \(\cos\theta=-\tfrac34\),
\[
\sin\theta=\sqrt{1-\tfrac{9}{16}}=\frac{\sqrt7}{4},\qquad
85-36\!\left(-\tfrac34\right)=85+27=112=16\cdot 7.
\]
Hence
\[
2[ABC]_{\max}=18\cdot\frac{\sqrt7}{4}+12\sqrt{112}
=\frac{9\sqrt7}{2}+48\sqrt7
=\frac{105\sqrt7}{2}.
\]
Therefore
\[
[ABC]_{\max}=\boxed{\dfrac{105\sqrt7}{4}}.
\]

### PROOF COMPLETE
